x: The chief feature of the race was the forward running of several of the younger school, particularly Stan Eeles who perhaps ran his best race to date—Stan has the makings of a real runner if he will get down to it, Fred Clay, John Brown, Bob Boyden, Norman Walker and Alf Heathfield.
Norman Walker is to be thanked for this, as he only turned up to watch but was pressed into service with “ borrowed ” togs in order for us to field a complete team.
Norman Walker It is with deepest sorrow that we have to report the death of Norman Walker, who passed away on Saturday, November 25th, at the early age of 24 years.
